headline: **MLB Daily Recap: June 2, 2026**
article:
The Detroit Tigers edged out the Tampa Bay Rays in a high-scoring matchup, securing a 10-9 victory. Dillon Dingler led the Tigers' offense with a 4-hit, 2-home run performance. The Miami Marlins secured a 7-3 victory over the Washington Nationals, with Heriberto Hernández leading the offense with a home run and two RBIs. Sandy Alcantara earned the win for the Marlins. The Kansas City Royals dominated the Cincinnati Reds, securing a 9-2 victory. Lane Thomas led the Royals' offense with a 3-hit, 1-home run performance, driving in 4 runs.

Several key players are dealing with injuries, impacting their teams' lineups. Brooks Kriske, a right-handed pitcher for the Athletics, has been transferred from the 15-day injured list to the 60-day injured list due to a right shoulder impingement. Ramón Laureano, a left fielder for the San Diego Padres, has been placed on the 10-day injured list retroactive to May 31, 2026, with right hip inflammation. Nick Pivetta, a right-handed pitcher for the San Diego Padres, has been transferred from the 15-day injured list to the 60-day injured list with right elbow inflammation.

The Minnesota Twins have made a trade, acquiring right-handed pitcher Justin Lawrence from the Pittsburgh Pirates in exchange for cash considerations. The Detroit Tigers traded right-handed pitcher Connor Seabold to the Toronto Blue Jays for left-handed pitcher Juanmi Vasquez. The Colorado Rockies traded left-handed pitcher Carson Palmquist to the Washington Nationals for cash.
